scope: Same-PID primary revival, stale-fence rejection and group cleanup

findings.original: Normal takeover removes the old member before replaying a received action to backup. Forced AMQP connection close can cancel an in-flight consumer handler.
findings.resolution: E1-c-only DeferredPrimaryRemoval retains exactly the old primary/session until backup applied, same-PID revival and durable exact stale-result marker; then original SDK removal is flushed.

Suspend branch resumes without ExperimentExit; PID/start ticks and canonical request digest are checked. Controller requires matching startup/suspend/revive/result markers and zero primary plus one backup matched modifying-call return.

Original approval is never renewed. Controller requires more than five seconds remaining before owned SIGCONT and accepts only rejected/rejected_stale_fence for the original operation. Expiry/cancellation cannot count as success.

Adapter detaches in finally; existing owned group close is reused. Controller restore checks the exact owned PID and continues it if still stopped before parent restoration. Failed restoration remains explicit.
